engineering.semantic_gate: All six actual_native FINAL composite decisions must match the exposed authored oracle. Lexical/positional final correctness and all raw-readout correctness remain descriptive. Every24 raw readout/evidence/certificate integrity check is mandatory.

readout.binary_derived_view: Yes=pE>0.5, exacthalfNo; No=pC+pN. Derived consistency only, not a replacement typed decision or headline3-way accuracy.
readout.proper_scores: Report BOTH fixed final composite and raw T1 three-way stable-softmax metrics. Mean sum(p-y)^2 Brier and mean -ln(max(pgold,1e-12)) NLL with explicit clipping count/unclipped finiteness. A wrong one-hot certificate incurs infinite unclipped NLL, retained as such through finiteness flag and clipped score. No fitted temperature or probability selection.
readout.typed_prediction: Original raw E,N,C first-maximum/T1 probabilities are always retained. Only engineering regressions may use an independently replayable whole-input one-hot certificate. On DEV the final distribution/argmax must equal raw T1 exactly with proof_disabled_for_DEV, even if a grammar rule might otherwise apply.

reporting.full104: Not attempted; known full-input16KiB blocker is not repeated or converted into an excerpt104 claim.

sampling_and_uncertainty: Six exposed authored regression cases are separate from eight newly reserved document clusters ×three correlated legal hypotheses. Report class denominators, per-document deltas, raw/final/certificate coverage and uncertainty. Do not treat24cases as independent or compare different banks as a causal old/new model benchmark.

source_data.isolation: Later authorized projection/scorer parses the complete publicly annotated JSON in RAM. Field access is logical and audited, not OS-enforced label secrecy. Current projection traverses only selected text/hypothesis fields and source IDs; future scorer exactly24 selected DEV choices; no evidence lists.
source_data.normalization: Authoritative canonical text hash = SHA256 UTF8(' '.join(text.casefold().split())). Normalization does not establish semantic or foundation decontamination.
source_data.transformations: Select fixed8 original TRAIN documents ×three fixed hypotheses; preserve text/hypotheses and add role/identity metadata. DEV-only diagnostic, not official held-out benchmark.

timing_and_resources: Report all four arm reader/forward p50/p95, query/native retrieval, initialization/cleanup and inclusive wall/RSS scopes with CPU0,1. Original+expanded native query timing and count are explicit; no isolated kernel or hidden opaque-internal count claims.

proof_method.independent_auditor: decision_proof_audit.py rederives parsing/deduction independently; never imports candidate proof implementation
proof_method.whole_input_rule: Only the complete original supplied input may establish a proof. Every clause must be parsed into the frozen typed grammar with unambiguous scope and a consistent theory; unknown or unsupported syntax, incomplete coverage or ambiguity must fall back to raw NLI. A retrieval miss is never a NotMentioned certificate.
proof_method.numeric_rule: A numerical contradiction requires the same typed event, reference date, unit and exclusive EXACTLY duration with incompatible exact values, with no unresolved exception/scope.
proof_method.not_mentioned_rule: An open-world constraint model must permit both the typed claim and its negation while satisfying the fully parsed supplied input. Missing a retrieved passage or literal keyword is insufficient.
proof_method.probabilities: ONEHOT only for a replayable deductive certificate; rawT1 unchanged otherwise. Certificates are never fit, calibrated or selected from gold.
proof_method.retrieval_control: The identical composite policy sees the identical immutable full supplied source for native, lexical and positional arms. Only each arm raw NLI evidence context differs.
proof_method.application_scope: ONLY EXPOSED_DEV_REGRESSION. Every DEV decision has certificate:null, final==rawT1, fallback_reason:proof_disabled_for_DEV. No proof call can change a DEV decision.

raw_derived_ablation.zero_real_DEV_certificate_coverage: Mandatory by design; proof component UNTESTED on DEV. Only query/retrieval efficacy may be diagnosed.

query_treatment.source_blind: Pure fixed transformation of the original hypothesis. No task/case/document IDs, labels, new input documents or source corpus lookup; one formula and fixed cap, never a configuration grid.
query_treatment.causal_control: native_original same model/index/packing with original BGE query
query_treatment.lexical_control: The SAME expanded query tokens with fixed Jaccard ranking
query_treatment.NLI_claim: Every arm retains the exact whole original hypothesis; query expansion never changes the NLI claim or source evidence text.
query_treatment.native_bundle: Two ordered query vectors/receipts per case, original and expanded, over each document single native index.
query_treatment.validation: Independent query receipt replay from the frozen declarative policy and original hypothesis before any source gold choice.
